lines.text: Down the hole and straight into a fight. How curious!
lines.spoken: Down the hole... and straight into a fight. How curious!

lines.text: I have had stranger mornings than you, and they all had better manners.
Do sit down. Oh, you already have.
That was the shortest tea party I have ever attended.
Your cards disappear. Mine march in and poke you.
I have fallen down deeper holes than your tomb.
